Shipping & Delivery Policy

Last Updated: January 24, 2026

Table of Contents

1. Introduction 2. Service Area 3. Delivery Modes & Timelines 4. Shipping Charges 5. Order Tracking 6. Delivery Attempts 7. Damaged or Missing Items 8. Contact Us

1. Introduction

At Kirihat, we are committed to delivering fresh groceries and essentials to your doorstep with speed and reliability. This Shipping & Delivery Policy outlines our delivery process, timelines, and charges to ensure a transparent shopping experience for our valued customers in Dhubri.

2. Service Area

Currently Serving

We are currently operating exclusively in Dhubri, Assam, serving the following PIN code:

  • 783334 (Kachakhana, Golakganj, and surrounding areas)

We are working hard to expand our services to more neighborhoods soon. Please check our app for the most up-to-date service availability.

3. Delivery Modes & Timelines

We offer flexible delivery options to suit your needs:

⚡

Instant Delivery

~20 Minutes

Get your essentials delivered in minutes! Available for eligible products and locations within our optimized delivery zones.

🚚

Standard Delivery

2 - 4 Hours

Perfect for larger bulk orders or items from specific vendors. Orders placed before 6 PM are typically delivered the same day.

Note: Delivery times are estimates and may vary due to traffic, weather conditions, or operational challenges.

4. Shipping Charges

We strive to keep our delivery fees affordable. Shipping charges are calculated based on your order value and delivery type:

  • Free Delivery: On all orders above ₹499.
  • Standard Fee: A nominal fee of ₹25 applies to orders below ₹499.
  • Small Cart Fee: For orders below ₹100, a small cart fee of ₹10 may apply to ensure operational sustainability.

Final delivery charges will be clearly displayed at the checkout screen before you confirm your order.

5. Order Tracking

Stay updated on your order's journey every step of the way:

  • Real-Time Tracking: Once your order is out for delivery, you can track your Rider's live location directly within the Kirihat App.
  • Status Updates: You will receive notifications for Order Confirmation, Packing, Out for Delivery, and Successful Delivery.
  • SMS/In-App Alerts: Important updates will be sent via SMS or push notifications.

6. Delivery Attempts

To ensure successful delivery:

  • Our Rider will attempt to call you if they cannot locate your address or if you are unavailable.
  • One Attempt: We typically attempt delivery once. If you are unavailable, the order may be cancelled, or you may need to reschedule via customer support (subject to availability).
  • Secure Drop: You may request a "Leave at Door" or "Leave with Neighbor" option through the app instruction notes, but Kirihat is not responsible for the package once left as per your instructions.

7. Damaged or Missing Items

If you receive an order with damaged, incorrect, or missing items, please report it immediately.

For detailed information on how to request a return or refund, please refer to our Return & Refund Policy.
